title: Vaerion research evidence record (v1)
description: Evidence for research-derived content (constitution D-O: research is declared, broker-mediated, journaled; external content is untrusted and fenced; provenance is mandatory). Document BYTES live in the content-addressed blob store; the record carries only the blob_ref plus a bounded fenced excerpt. An evidence record is always built FROM a fenced block — unfenced external content has no path into a record, and thus no path into the journal (E1401). Evidence without provenance is hearsay and must never exist.

trace_id.description: Trace the evidence was produced within.

capability.description: Declared research capability that produced the evidence (E1403 otherwise).

fencing.description: Fencing level of the content. Untrusted content never enters trusted channels (E1401).

source_id.description: Identifier of the declared source within the capability.

blob_ref.description: Content-addressed reference to the full document bytes in the blob store (constitution D-E: blob_ref, not bytes).

alg.description: Hash algorithm of the blob store; blake3 only.

hash.description: 64-character lowercase blake3 hex digest of the stored bytes.

size.description: Byte size of the stored content.

excerpt.description: Bounded fenced excerpt of the document content, as carried by the fenced block.

provenance.description: Mandatory provenance: the exact source, content fingerprint, retrieval time, locator, and the transformation chain that produced the stored form (fencing is always the chain's base).

evidence_id.description: Must equal the enclosing evidence_id (coherence is verified, never assumed).

source_path.description: Path or URI of the source as declared in the capability.

fingerprint.description: Content-derived identity of the document; reproducible from the bytes alone.

size.description: UTF-8 byte length of the document.

doc_id.description: Stable document identifier within the source.

locator.description: Locator of the content within the source (anchor, offset, line range, or equivalent).

transformation_chain.description: Ordered transformations from retrieved bytes to stored form; non-empty. The base step is fencing (e.g. fence:untrusted).

recorded_at.description: Timestamp the evidence record was built (RFC3339).
